body.title: SQL references miss across 2- and 3-part names, fold quoted case, keep stale inferred links and re-scan every pending row on each .sql save
body.reproduction:
Four cases, each in a repository with .sql files:
(L4) Define `CREATE TABLE app.users (...)` in one file and reference `db.app.users` from a view in another (or define `db.app.users` and reference `app.users`). Observed: the REFERENCES row stays unresolved. Expected: the two names meet when one is a qualified suffix of the other, and stay ambiguous when several definitions fit.
(L3) Define `CREATE TABLE "Users" (...)` and `CREATE TABLE users (...)`, and reference `"Users"`. Observed: both definitions are candidates (names are lower-cased), so the reference is ambiguous or links to the wrong one. Expected: a quoted identifier keeps its case and matches only the same quoted name; unquoted names keep folding.
(L1) A view references `users`; one file defines `users`, so the reference is linked ('inferred'). Later another file defines a second `users` (another schema). Observed: the old inferred edge stays as if still the only candidate. Expected: the reference is re-checked and becomes ambiguous (unresolved CALLS rows behave the same today).
(L2) In a repository with many pending SQL references, save any .sql file. Observed: the settle re-reads and re-attempts every pending SQL reference of the repository. Expected: the re-attempt costs in proportion to what the saved files can change.
body.rootCause: (L4) The resolver indexes SQL tables and views by lower-cased full name and, for a qualified name, by its last segment only (src/indexer/cross-file-resolver.ts:1042-1045); sqlCandidates looks a reference up by its exact lower-cased name in both maps (src/indexer/cross-file-resolver.ts:798-801), so a qualified reference finds only the identical qualified definition and a 3-part name never meets a 2-part one. (L3) Names are lower-cased without regard to quoting: the reader's same-file map (src/indexer/parser/sql.ts:150, src/indexer/parser/sql.ts:156), CTE names (src/indexer/parser/sql.ts:75-81) and the resolver index and lookup (src/indexer/cross-file-resolver.ts:800, src/indexer/cross-file-resolver.ts:1043). (L1) resolveSqlReference runs only on unresolved rows (src/indexer/cross-file-resolver.ts:809-813); an edge already resolved as 'inferred' is never revisited when a new definition with the same name is committed. (L2) In settle mode, any committed .sql file makes sqlReferencesAwaitingCommitted list all of the repository's unresolved relations and re-attempt every pending SQL reference (src/indexer/cross-file-resolver.ts:819-830), a deviation recorded on the SQL cross-file Story's BUILD.
body.fixIntent: SQL references resolve the way SQL names work: a qualified reference meets a definition whose qualified name it is a suffix of (or that is a suffix of it), ambiguity stays ambiguous and is never guessed; quoted identifiers keep their case while unquoted ones fold; an inferred link is re-checked when a new definition could make it ambiguous; and a settle after a .sql save re-attempts only the pending references the saved files' names can affect. Each case gets a test; behaviour for already-correct cases (exact names, bare names, same-file links) is unchanged.
